q.q: Which of the following is the fastest type of memory?
q.x: Registers are inside the CPU and are the fastest. The memory hierarchy from fastest to slowest: Registers > Cache > RAM > SSD/Hard disk.

q.q: Which memory is volatile — its contents are lost when power is turned off?
q.x: RAM is volatile. ROM, hard disks and SSDs retain data without power (non-volatile).
